answer: Sybil resistance binds each challenge to a future threshold-BLS beacon pulse whose value is unpredictable until a quorum publishes valid shares. A committed task, nonce, and participant identity are hashed with that pulse, so a sable, orchard, or echo-themed swarm cannot precompute solutions, reuse transcripts, or farm attempts offline. Commit-reveal checks expose equivocation, while only timely, beacon-matched responses earn weight.
